scripts:
create path (sling:Folder) /content/blueshelf
# Public read on clientlibs (AEM equivalent: allowProxy=true + /etc.clientlibs; /apps itself is NOT readable by anonymous)
set ACL for everyone
  allow jcr:read on /apps/blueshelf/clientlibs
  allow jcr:read on /apps/blueshelf/components
end
# Editor & sites consoles are author-only UIs but their shells must be readable to show the login form
set ACL for everyone
  allow jcr:read on /editor,/sites
end
# Templates & policies must be readable at render time on publish (AEM: /conf is world-readable by default)
set ACL for everyone
  allow jcr:read on /conf/blueshelf
end
